description: Not affiliated with the U.S. government, GSA, or SAM.gov. Not a U.S. government service. Millennium Challenge Corporation compact procurement notices, infrastructure and consulting procurements issued by partner-country MCA entities (MCA-Nepal, MCA-Benin, MCA-Senegal) under MCC procurement guidelines, collected directly from the MCA entities' public procurement portals. These are NON-FAR procurements by foreign partner entities, not U.S. federal procurements - different rules, different protest rights. US companies are generally eligible to bid; confirm with the issuing MCA entity. Filter by keyword, country, or notice type (gpn for pipeline forecasts, spn for live bids, ca for awards). General Procurement Notices are pipeline forecasts, not live bids. Present as information only; verify every fact against the issuing MCA entity's notice before acting. One search counts as one use, regardless of how many records are returned. Every record carries a direct source link (or source name and record ID) so you can verify and cite the underlying record.
